description: Defines internal result classes for DNS host resolution, including data, metadata, error, and alias results, with serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalResult
classes.description: Base class for internal DNS resolution results, supporting different result types and serialization.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalDataResult
classes.description: Represents DNS resolution data results, including endpoints, strings, and hosts.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalMetadataResult
classes.description: Represents connection metadata associated with DNS results.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalErrorResult
classes.description: Represents an error encountered during DNS resolution.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalAliasResult
classes.description: Represents an alias (CNAME or HTTPS alias) result.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Static method to deserialize from a base::Value.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serialize the result object to a base::Value.
